ranked.text: The planning-api Deployment was scaled to zero, leaving the planning-api Service without endpoints and causing grid-operator plan fetches to fail.
A recent GitOps commit or rollout touching planning-api changed the Deployment, reducing desired_replicas to zero.
An upstream failure in forecast-pipeline or ingestion triggered the incident.
Grid-operator plan fetch failures are caused by an independent network or Service-level disconnect between grid-operator and planning-api, not by missing planning-api replicas.
